items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I went over to his house to congratulate him and thank him

ctx.x: I guess he was listening to you enough at the time to have warranted his naming quite a well known tune after you.

Yeah, well that was a surprise to me and I went over to his house to congratulate him and thank him because I thought that was very nice of him, 'cause I didn't think he was listening to me that way. But Coltrane was a very humble person and he listened to everybody and that's why he was able to come out with his own style. Because if you don't have a good foundation you can't build a good house. And he contributed and he was a marvelous saxophone player. And it is a great loss that he's gone, you know, because…
And who are some of the other people that have given you recognition for the role you played in those years at the Paradise?
